summaryZh: 拉格朗日漂流器实验室发展漂流器和传感器设计，支持海洋观测及科学研究。团队使用漂流器阵列，并提供基于漂流器的分析产品。

evidence.quote: Global Drifter Program Real-Time Array Status Map View Global Drifter Program Operational Dashboard Hurricane Viewer What’s new LDL Partners with Nemo’s Garden and the University of Aversa to Provide Information on Wave Conditions > Read more Directional Wave Spectra Drifter Array Measures Massive Waves on Hurricane Ian’s Approach > Read more Global Drifter Program Wave Drifters Measure the 2020–2021 Hurricane Seasons > Read more A More Bio-Friendly Drifter > Read more Global Drifter Program Deploys Wave Drifters Under Hurricane Teddy > Read more Drifters Deployed in Anticipation of Hurricane Isaias (August 2020) > Read more Measuring Greenland’s Helheim Fjord Circulation Using the Custom ADOS Drifter > Read more Improved West Coast Weather Reports Supported by SVP Drifters with Sea Level Pressure Sensors > Read more LDL Introduces the Directional Wave Spectra Drifter > Read more Drifting Buoys Help Scientists Study Waves in the Gulf Stream > Read more LDL in the Media News Archive What are drifters and drogues? DRIFTERS are oceanographic instruments that are composed of a surface float tethered to a drogue. They provide essential information on the upper ocean such as temperature, salinity, current direction, and speed. > Learn more about drifter types A DROGUE is an essential component of a water-following device. It consists of a carefully designed sea anchor that ensures the drifters follow the water with high accuracy. Surface waves that frequently exceed amplitudes of several meters and the wind blowing at the surface of the ocean do not affect it. SEE ALSO : Niiler, P. P., A. Sybrandy, K. Bi, P. M. Poulain, and D. Bitterman. 1995. Measurements of the water-following capability of holey-sock and TRISTAR drifters. Deep Sea Research Part I 42:1,951–1,964, https://doi.org/10.1016/0967-0637(95)00076-3 . Technology Development and Custom-Made Drifters The Lagrangian Drifter Laboratory innovates drifter and sensor designs as demanded by science applications and evolving requirements. Drifter Types Nine standard drifter types are available immediately for deployment. Drifter-Based Science Products Drifter arrays complement the ocean observing and modeling components of science programs. The LDL provides analytical products that support programs’ research objectives. Subscription Service To meet scientific and operational needs, custom sensor/drifter packages that fit within the Global Drifter Array can be deployed on a subscription basis to collect additional ocean variables.
